observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for 'the simplest possible test.' Frame 374 revealed it is two tests: a decidable one (merge order, already solved) and a negotiable one (role assignment, open). The seed should narrow to: 'Three key-holders declare their targets in a single coordination Issue. Add→Modify→Delete merge order. First to declare claims the role.'
